environment: One operator works in this personal FuguBSD workspace. No production traffic and no third-party data depend on it. The workspace repository has no remote and no CI.
Each project clone under Projects/ declares its Scaleway infrastructure as OpenTofu stacks. tofu apply executes a saved plan, and the operator approves the diff in chat first.
Budget alerts at EUR 300 per month, a price forecast gate, and an idle watchdog cap the Scaleway spend.
gh workflow run dispatches the campaign workflows of the operator's own repositories. The workflows enforce the same spend gates, a lease expiry, and a teardown watchdog.
scw iam api-key create and delete perform the CI credential delegation that the project RUNBOOK documents. Each minted key has a project scope and an expiry date.
ssh-keygen mints the campaign SSH keypairs, and gh secret set stores minted credentials for CI. Secret values go to gitignored files under explore/, never to command output.
Shell state does not persist between tool calls. One command line therefore sources .env, exports the keys, and runs one tool.

hooks.command: jq -r '.cwd, (.name // empty)' | { read -r c; read -r n; exec perl "$c/scripts/worktree.pl" -C "$c" create "$n"; }
hooks.statusMessage: Bootstrapping worktree: cloning projects and copying .env files

hooks.command: jq -r '.worktree_path // empty' | { read -r w; [ -n "$w" ] || exit 0; r="${w%/.claude/worktrees/*}"; n="${w##*/.claude/worktrees/}"; echo "worktree kept: $w" >&2; echo "to remove it: make -C \"$r\" worktree-remove NAME=\"$n\"" >&2; exit 0; }
hooks.statusMessage: Keeping the worktree: removal is manual
